lesson.title: 3.4 Yes and No
lesson.unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to greet people and give a name, age, origin and job, ask and answer yes/no questions with be, and describe who owns things.
lesson.goal: Ask and answer yes/no questions with be about known people and actions: Is he...?, Is she...?, Are you...?
lesson.grammar_function: Be before the subject for a yes/no question; short answers Yes, he is. / No, she is not. / Yes, I am.
lesson.prerequisite: 1.8 not; 3.2 I/you; 3.3 am/is/are and What are you doing?.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Ask Is he...? and Are you...? about known actions and give short yes and no answers.

accepts.conversational-response: Yes and No are the short answers this lesson teaches; they are complete responses by nature.
